segments.name: The Cheesecake Factory Restaurants
segments.description: Operates upscale casual dining restaurants offering an extensive menu and premium desserts to a broad customer base in the United States and Canada.
segments.evidence: As of February 23, 2026, we operated 216 The Cheesecake Factory restaurants, which strive to provide a distinctive, high-quality dining experience at moderate prices by offering an extensive, innovative and evolving menu in an upscale casual, high-energy setting with attentive, efficient and friendly service.

segments.name: North Italia
segments.description: Operates the North Italia brand of restaurants, one of the company's reportable segments.
segments.evidence: Based on quantitative thresholds set forth in ASC 280, Segment Reporting, The Cheesecake Factory, North Italia and the other FRC brands are the only businesses that meet the criteria of a reportable operating segment .

segments.name: Other FRC
segments.description: Comprises the additional restaurant brands within the Fox Restaurant Concepts portfolio, reported as a reportable segment.
segments.evidence: additional brands within our Fox Restaurant Concepts ("Other FRC") portfolio (55 locations).

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Combines the Flower Child and bakery operating segments, businesses not qualifying as operating segments, and unallocated corporate expenses.
segments.evidence: The remaining operating segments (Flower Child and our bakery division) along with our businesses that do not qualify as operating segments are combined in Other.

revenueModel.text: Restaurant customers pay for dining and off-premise meals, international licensees pay licensing fees, and third-party bakery customers purchase cheesecakes and baked products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our bakery division operates two facilities that produce quality cheesecakes and other baked products for our restaurants, international licensees and third-party bakery customers.
